title: Edition
description: One edition of an issue (production/editions/<ED_ID>/edition.yaml): the exact render of every page, an optional cover render, and the exports built from them. Only renders reviewed pass or fixed enter a non-draft edition; exports are never overwritten.

id.description: Edition ID, e.g. ED_001_01. Matches the directory name.

changes.description: What changed since the superseded edition.

cover.description: The cover render that ships as the first page of every export, or null for an edition without a cover.

render.description: The exact cover render that ships.

file.description: Path of the cover render file, relative to the workspace root.

lettered_file.description: Overlay mode: path of the lettered cover. Else null.

pages.description: Pages in reading order, once each, with no gaps.

file.description: Path of the render file, relative to the workspace root.

lettered_file.description: Overlay mode: path of the lettered output. Else null.

exports.description: Exports built from this edition. May be empty before the first build.

file.description: Path of the export, relative to the workspace root.

built_at.description: When the export was built, or null.

notes.description: Free-form notes for people. Never read by scripts.
